fields.questionText:
For the quadratic equation x² + 2(k + 1)x + k² = 0, where k is a real number:
(i) Find the discriminant in terms of k.
(ii) Find the value of k for which the roots are real and equal.
(iii) Find the values of k for which the roots are real and distinct, and the values for which the equation has no real roots.
fields.answer: (i) D = 4(2k + 1)  (ii) k = −1/2  (iii) real and distinct for k > −1/2; no real roots for k < −1/2
fields.finalAnswer: (i) D = 4(2k + 1)  (ii) k = −1/2  (iii) real and distinct for k > −1/2; no real roots for k < −1/2
solutionSteps: [1 mark] (ii) Real and equal roots: D = 0 ⇒ 2k + 1 = 0 ⇒ k = −1/2.
[1 mark] (iii) Real and distinct roots: D > 0 ⇒ k > −1/2. No real roots: D < 0 ⇒ k < −1/2.

rationale: Part (iv) 'imaginary' roots is out (real roots only) → rephrased 'no real roots'. Not a case (no scenario) → retagged Short/C/3 with 3 parts. Removed garbled steps ('= 4(k+1) [correction…]'). D = 4(2k+1) verified.

fields.questionText:
Car Production: An automobile manufacturer models the profit from the sale of its vehicles by the function P(x) = -x^2 + 350x - 6600, where P(x) is the profit in thousand Rupees and x is the number of automobiles made and sold. Answer the following questions based on this model:
(i) When no cars are produced, what is the profit/loss?
(ii) What is the break-even point? (the zero-profit point where P(x) = 0)
(iii) What is the profit/loss if 175 cars are produced?
(iv) What is the profit/loss if 400 cars are produced?

rationale: Stem said capacity 'up to 300 cars' yet (iv) uses 400 and break-even 330 — removed the capacity clause (no data invented). Evaluating P(x) and solving P(x)=0 is in-syllabus QE. 'Maximum Profit' title (nothing maximised) renamed. Answers verified.

solutionSteps: [1 mark] (iii) Solve h(t) = 1344: -16t^2 + 240t + 544 = 1344 => t^2 - 15t + 50 = 0 => (t - 5)(t - 10) = 0 => t = 5 or 10. The quadratic gives two times for the same height: the rocket passes 1344 ft going up at t = 5 and again coming down at t = 10.

[1 mark] (iv) Height H is reached when 16t^2 - 240t + (H - 544) = 0 has real roots: D = 240^2 - 64(H - 544) >= 0 => H - 544 <= 900 => H <= 1444. Maximum height = 1444 ft (equal roots, t = 240/32 = 7.5 s).
[1 mark] (v) Airborne until h(t) = 0: -16t^2 + 240t + 544 = 0 => t^2 - 15t - 34 = 0 => (t - 17)(t + 2) = 0 => t = 17 (reject t = -2). The rocket was airborne for 17 s.
fields.finalAnswer: (i) 1344 ft  (ii) 1344 ft  (iii) h(t) = 1344 has two roots t = 5 and t = 10 (going up, then coming down)  (iv) 1444 ft  (v) 17 s
